title: CodeROI Launches the CodeROI AI Agent: R&D Tax Credits, Section 174, and Software Capitalization on Your AI Spend
summary: CodeROI Launches the CodeROI AI Agent: R&D Tax Credits, Section 174, and Software Capitalization on Your AI Spend Yahoo Finance
body: CodeROI Launches the CodeROI AI Agent: R&D Tax Credits, Section 174, and Software Capitalization on Your AI Spend Morningstar
summaryZh: CodeROI 推出了专门面向研发税收抵免、Section 174 法规以及软件资本化的 AI Agent，旨在自动化处理企业的研发支出合规与税务申报工作。原始信息显示：CodeROI Launches the CodeROI AI Agent: R&D Tax Credits, Section 174, and Software Capitalization on Your AI Spend Morningstar。该消息由Morningstar发布，主题为“CodeROI Launches the CodeROI AI Agent: R&D Tax Credits, Section 174, and Software Capitalization on Your AI Spend”。其重要性主要体现在：发布了针对特定财务与税务场景的专业 AI Agent 产品。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
